publication: New measurements stay in this nested evidence directory; no leaderboard/Table6/paper-reference promotion. Historical aggregates/paper metadata remain unchanged.
data_policy: Use official fetch script one sequence at a time, hash/verify inputs and expected frames, run all its jobs, save artifacts, then remove only the owned downloaded sequence before fetching another.
